evidence.rationale: The listing and matching VIN history establish a consistent 30,959-mile, clean-title, manual S52 M Roadster with no reported accidents, currently priced near the mileage-adjusted fair-value midpoint for comparable sold cars. Nothing in the listing documents the model's two highest-stakes weak points — rear subframe/trunk-floor integrity and cooling-system history — and no service records of any kind accompany five prior owners on a low-mileage car. The VIN history also shows this same car's Cars.com listing marked 'Sold' as of 2026-09-20, while this CarGurus listing's last checked status (2026-09-04) still shows active, leaving current availability unresolved. Photos attached show a cosmetically clean example but do not extend to underside or trunk-floor structural areas. S54 rod-bearing risk is not applicable to this 1998 S52 car.
